# Prime Flash MoE - Faster MoE Kernels optimized for Blackwell

AUG 13TH, 2026

# Prime Flash MoE - Faster MoE Kernels optimized for Blackwell

## Introduction

Prime Flash MoE is a set of Blackwell-optimized CUDA kernels that avoid materializing certain intermediate tensors and, in the fused configuration avoid materializing the activation as well, thus saving a lot of memory traffic. The kernels are up to 2.4× faster than PyTorch grouped GEMM, and deliver a ~2.3× speedup across the 4k-128k token range. We also integrated the kernel into our prime-rl framework to accelerate the forward pass of MoE models.
